description: This file implements WebAuthn-based security key registration and encryption key derivation functions for the Notesnook project, including functions to register security keys and derive encryption keys using WebAuthn extensions.

methods.name: registerSecurityKey
methods.description: Registers a new security key for a user, utilizing WebAuthn API and extensions.

methods.name: getEncryptionKey
methods.description: Derives an encryption key using WebAuthn PRF extension and HKDF.
